text: DSH Skin Center 是面向 DSH Web GUI 的皮肤与外观管理插件，在设置界面提供皮肤目录、主题预览和背景控制。用户可以浏览内置及已安装的皮肤，实时试用后应用，也能退出预览恢复已选外观；切换在页面内完成并保存选择。插件还提供独立的明暗主题配色编辑、背景遮罩与模糊、输入框玻璃效果和气泡透明度调节，并可展示壁纸或其他插件主题的接入卡片。皮肤以目录资源形式加载，支持用户皮肤目录。适合想个性化 DSH 网页界面、比较视觉方案或微调配色和背景的用户。需要 DSH Web GUI；无需额外 API 密钥，安装市场皮肤时使用 DSH Market。

DSH Skin Center manages skins in the DSH Web GUI. Browse installed looks, preview and apply one live, or restore the saved choice without reloading. It also offers light and dark palettes and background blur controls. Add a user skin directory to personalize the interface; no API key is needed.

DSH Skin Center 的功能「皮肤目录」：在设置中列出官方默认外观、内置皮肤和用户皮肤，并报告无效目录。打开皮肤中心即可浏览已安装项目。
DSH Skin Center 的功能「实时试用与应用」：在页面内切换皮肤预览，退出时恢复已保存选择，应用时保存新选择，无需重载页面。
DSH Skin Center 的功能「自定义主题」：为浅色与深色模式分别编辑强调色、背景、前景和对比度，并预览、应用或重置。
DSH Skin Center 的功能「背景控制」：调节背景遮罩、对话背景模糊、输入框区域模糊和气泡透明度，设置保存在活动状态中。
DSH Skin Center 的功能「用户皮肤目录」：扫描 DSH_HOME 下的皮肤目录，也支持通过 DSH_SKINS_HOME 或 DSH_SKINS_DIR 指定位置。
DSH Skin Center 的使用须知：浏览器端会向 dsh-market.com 每天发送一次匿名安装心跳；源码将其实现为 telemetry 请求。

text: @linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center README · Wallpaper Engine：Wallpaper Engine support is **not bundled** here. It lives in its own plugin, [dsh-wallpaper-engine](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine) (`dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine`), which owns the wallpaper library, the video / web / scene rendering paths, the wallpaper settings surface and the glass over the wallpaper. It is the **recommended** Workshop item for wallpapers, and the skin center card installs it for you.

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center README · Wallpaper Engine：**One-click install**: open 设置 → Web 扩展 → 皮肤 and press **Install** on the card's wallpaper notice. The install goes through whichever plugin-management face the running host publishes — the official in-process plugin manager when it is there (the same call the official Plugins page makes, and the only writer on the packaged Desktop client), otherwise the family plugin-manager face. A host that publishes neither keeps the copy-command fallback.

By hand, the equivalent is:

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center README · Wallpaper Engine：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine
```

Restart the host afterwards (`dsh web`; DSH Desktop: fully quit the app and reopen it). The plugin adds its own settings page for choosing and tuning wallpapers.
@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center README · How the two share the page：The two plugins take turns rather than overlapping, and the handoff is automatic:
section: How the two share the page

text:
@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center README · How the two share the page：- **While a wallpaper renders**, the plugin stamps the stable `body[data-we-wallpaper]` attribute. The skin center reads that attribute and **stands its own visual work down**: no skin CSS, no skin background art, no hooks, no composer frost, and the `html[data-dsh-skin]` stamp comes off the page. Whatever you picked in the skin center is remembered but not painted — that plugin rewrites the same shell and paints its own glass, so anything else would fight it.
- **When the wallpaper stops**, the attribute clears and the remembered skin repaints on its own, with no reload and no re-applying.
- **When you ask for a skin yourself**, try-on and apply claim the stage once: the skin paints and `html[data-dsh-skin]` flips even while a wallpaper renders, because that stamp is the signal the plugin watches to hand the page back. Re-applying the skin you already wear counts as an action too, so the stamp is written on every apply rather than only when the selection changes. The claim is one-shot — if nothing answers within a short hand-back window, the skin stands down by itself and waits for the wallpaper to stop.

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center README · Configuration：- **Enable switch**: turns the whole card (try-on / apply / background controls) on or off; persisted in the v2 active-state document.
- **Background sliders**: occlusion (0–100%), two backdrop blur radii, input-card blur (0–20 px), and bubble opacity (0–100%); persisted in the same v2 document.
- **Background persistence (remote-capable)**: background values live in the v2 active-state document (`$DSH_HOME/skin-center-active.json`, the `background` section) and are read/written through `GET|POST /api/skin-center/v2/active`, so paired remote desktops — where the settings surface is loopback-only — load and keep them across sessions. The `skin-background` section of the plugin's own configuration stays as the settings page's input face: a customized section is migrated into the v2 store once at boot, and later page edits are forwarded by the client. Card edits do not write back to that page, so it may show stale values until its next edit.
- **Custom theme**: light/dark accent, background, foreground and contrast profiles plus the applied marker; persisted as a versioned contract in the `skin-custom-theme` section of the pl

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center README · Security model：- All `/api/skin-center/*` routes are same-origin only: writes reject cross-site requests (Sec-Fetch-Site / Origin fence), and asset reads are contained inside each skin directory (path escapes fail closed).
- Skin CSS is sanitized (whitelist) before serving; `patches.css` (L3) is arbitrary CSS by design and disclosed as such — it runs with full page styling power and is not a security boundary.
- The CSS safety pipeline runs in a short-lived worker process, one worker per request, and the worker has exited before the stylesheet response is written. The host process therefore never loads the CSS parser and never maps its native addon, which is what lets a package manager replace the parser package while the host runs (issue #98).
- The pipeline belongs to one plugin mount: the mount creates it, injects it into the routes and disposes it with the mount. A remount therefore gets its own pipeline, and tearing down the old mount never disables the new one.
- The pipeline holds at most eight requests in total, the running one and the waiting ones alike. A request beyond that cap is refused at once with `503 css-transform-overl

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center README · Known limitations：- Inline styles written by plugins at runtime can only be overridden by L3 `!important` patches.
- Plugins that do not output semantic attributes (and have no stable DOM anchors) receive L1 token coverage only.
- Wallpaper pause-on-hidden, wallpaper blur, dimming and sound live in `dsh-plugin-wallpaper-engine`'s own settings; the skin center has no wallpaper controls and its card only reports the plugin's state.
- While one stylesheet transform is running, the worker process holds the CSS parser's native addon, and a package install in that exact window still sees a mapped addon on Windows. The window lasts one transform; the host process itself never holds it.
- A burst of more than eight stylesheet requests is refused with `503` for the requests beyond the cap; the client has to retry them.

@linxin666/dsh-client-ui-skin-center README · Telemetry：The browser half sends one anonymous install heartbeat per UTC day to dsh-market.com: a random localStorage id plus this package's name, nothing else. The server stores only a salted hash of that id, never IP addresses, and exposes aggregate counts only. See [docs/telemetry.md](../../docs/telemetry.md) for the full contract.

  src/core/manifest-v2/                     # manifest v2 types + fail-closed validator
  src/core/css-safety/                      # worker-scoped lightningcss scoping + whitelist pipeline
